name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
benefit_summary: Subsidy of 40-50% on farm equipment (tractors, power tillers, threshers, harvesters) — higher percentage for SC/ST, women, and small/marginal farmers
required_documents: Quotation from an empaneled equipment dealer
notes: VERIFY against your own smam_mechanization.txt — subsidy percentage depends on farmer category and equipment type, and there are often per-district or per-village annual caps on how many subsidies are approved.
